column2: Summons a Windfury Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enhances the melee attacks of all party or raid members within 30 yards. Each main hand hit has a 20% chance of granting the attacker 1 extra attack with 95 extra melee attack power. Lasts 5 min.

Summons an immobile Sentry Totem with 100 health at your feet for 5 min that allows vision of nearby area and warns of enemies that attack it. Right-Click on buff to switch back and forth between totem sight and Shaman sight.

The Druid’s form is a critical piece of information in combat and preserving the ability for players to see what form the Druid is currently in is important. We appreciate the desire for Druid players to still transform, so there are effects that will still work, it is just now much more limited and largely based on if that transform has other benefits (for example, Noggenfogger Elixir will still transform you because it lets you breathe underwater.)
The Hunter may now correctly have 1 active Fire Trap and 1 active Ice Trap (was 1 Trap among all types).
The Hunter's Fire traps now correctly scale with Attack Power.
The Quick and the Dead should now affect more Priest spells.
The Restorative Totems talent now correctly increases the effect of the entirety of Healing Stream totem (was the base value).

The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 10 min.\n\nOnly one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.
The effects that override shapeshifting now more closely resemble Classic wow.
The experience earned from killing creatures in dungeons has been increased by approximately 20%.
The flat damage on Shred's tooltip will now correctly scale with the % damage increase of the Savage Fury talent.
The lowest-cost talent point re-spec for Legacy Points now costs 1s, and the cost to re-spec will reduce by one re-spec per hour.
The new rank 1 is learned at level 30 (135 Mana, 113 to 145 Fire damage); the old ranks 1 to 3 are ranks 2 to 4 now, unchanged.
The new rank 2 is learned at level 38 (20 Mana, 133 Mana every 3 seconds); the old ranks 2 and 3 are ranks 3 and 4 now, unchanged.

There have been several bugs in the calculation of Rage gained from taking damage, and the bugs are fixed in this build. The typical Warrior or Druid should be gaining more Rage from taking damage.
Thick Hide: This talent is now properly implemented in code, rather than script, resolving some bugs with equipping gear while shapeshifted not triggering it.

Touch of the Dead no longer scales with Shadow increases on the target or the caster.

Weapon swaps
While in Cat Form, Bear Form, or Dire Bear Form, the Leader of the Pack increases the melee and ranged Critical Strike chance of all party or raid members within 45 yards by 3%.

Winter’s Chill change to: Gives your Frostbolt, Frost Blast, and Fingers of Frost empowered Ice Lance spells a 20/40/60/80/100% chance to apply Winter’s Chill, increasing the target’s damage taken from your next Cone of Cold by 5% and it gains an additional 7% of your spell damage, stacking up to 5 times.
With a wand equipped, the game shows the wand's speed as a cooldown and no Requires Wands line. Since build 70425 you stand still for 0.5 sec before it shoots (Blizzard's 15 Oct notes).
